name: Bilebrew
text: The Butcher knocks back an acrid concoction of spleen and gall, causing other Ogres nearby to attack their enemies with a cold fury and bitter determination. If the spell is cast, the Butcher and all friendly Ogres within the Area of Effect develop Hatred against a target (or group of targets) of the Butcher’s choice.

name: Bloodgruel
text: The butcher places a disembodied limb into trheir mouth and sucks out all the blood and marrow. As the Butcher gulps down the cocktail of juices, their gut gurgles with magical energy, either healing them or, if the maw is displeased, ravaging their insides. If the spell is cast, the Butcher should make an Easy (+4 SL) Endurance Test. If the test is passed, the Butcher heals 1 Wound plus 1 Wound for every +1 SL scored on the test. If the test is failed, the Butcher contracts the Bloody Flux.
adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty converted to Fifth Edition SL (core Appendix I p. 364).

name: Get Some Guts
text: The Butcher consumes the large intestine of a male Mournfang. For the duration of the spell any targets may ignore Broken Conditions.

name: Toothcracker
text: The Butcher grinds his way through a lump of earth- encrusted bedrock taken from the peak of a mountain, imbuing themself and their charges with supernatural resilience. The Butcher must take a Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance Test, and if they fail they lose 1 tooth for every –1 SL they score on the test. If the spell is cast successfully, the Butcher and all friendly Ogres within the Area of Effect benefit from +20 to any Endurance and Cool Tests they are called on to make, and +1 AP to all Hit Locations, for the duration of the spell.

name: Behave!
text: The Shaman snarls at a creature accompanying him, making them subservient. Any Squig, Giant Wolf, Spider (any size), or Snotling affected will follow the Shaman’s commands with the discipline of a well-trained dog.

name: Cunnin’ Words
text: The Shaman calls on Mork to trick a listener into hearing cogent, civilised discourse rather than the mad babble he usually utters. Treat as if the Shaman can speak whatever language the listener understands.

name: Curse of Da Bad Moon
text: The Shaman howls into the sky and summons a horrifying moon with a leering goblinoid face. Enemies in the Area of Effect are temporarily cursed. All gain +1 Fatigued Condition and suffer from a bout of pronounced ill luck. They may not use Fortune Points for the Duration.

name: Gift of the Spider-God
target: Forest Goblins in AoE (Willpower Bonus yards)
text: The Shaman hisses an invocation to the Feaster from Beyond to aid his allies. All affected allies gain the Venom Trait with Challenging (+0 SL) potency. If they already have the Venom Trait, it becomes Difficult (−1 SL) potency.
adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty converted to Fifth Edition SL (core Appendix I p. 364). Use current core Venom: Wounds inflict Poisoned; Challenging or Difficult specifies recovery Difficulty.

name: Gork’ll Fix It
text: The Shaman points a bony finger at a nearby enemy and curses them in the name of Gork. For the duration of the spell, the target suffers from a Fatigued Condition.

name: The Great Green Spite
text: The Shaman brings to focus the accumulated spite of nearby Goblins, manifesting it as a thoroughly nasty curse. For the duration of the spell, whenever a Goblin successfully strikes an enemy within the Area of Effect with a melee or ranged attack, it counts as a Critical Hit. If the Shaman casting this spell is a Hobgoblin, then the effects apply to Hobgoblins rather than Goblins.

name: Itchy Nuisance
text: The Shaman scratches his armpits and cackles, uttering nasty curses of poor hygiene and fungal mites. The target suffers –1 SL to all Tests for the duration of the spell as they try to scratch themselves. If they are wearing metal armour, the penalty is increased to –2 SL.

name: Mork Wants Ya!
text: The Shaman makes a pinching gesture with its clawed hand. Mirroring this action, a great green hand descends from the heavens to pinch a target between its huge fingers. They must win an Opposed Strength Test against a Strength of 80 in order to wriggle free in time. If the test is failed, they take a hit to the body of 10 Damage and are then dropped from a height of 2d10 yards.

name: Night Shroud
text: The Shaman tosses a black-capped nightshade mushroom into the air, which bursts to form a cloud of pitch darkness. Anyone within the cloud suffers from a Blinded Condition. Anyone attempting to move within the cloud must pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Perception Test or gain the Prone Condition. Characters with Night Vision or Dark Vision are immune to the effects of the spell.

name: Nikkit!
text: The Shaman conjures up a pair of green hands. He may attempt to pick the pocket of any target in range as if he were possessed of a Sleight of Hand skill of 55. If the attempt is successful, the target may make a Challenging (+0 SL) Perception Test to notice the hands (and loot) flying back to the Shaman.

name: Sneaky Stabbin’
target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Orcs and Goblins
text: The Shaman enchants his allies with mischievous power to find their enemies’ weak spots. Blows struck by affected targets possess the Impale and Penetrating Qualities.

name: Vindictive Glare
text: The Shaman sends green bolts of purest spite to fizz and explode amidst the foe. This is a magic missile with Damage +4 that targets everyone in the Area of Effect. Any target who takes damage must pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Cool Test or suffer from a Stunned Condition.

name: ‘Ard as Nails
text: The Shaman imbues a target within range with Waaagh! energy, causing them to grow increasingly belligerent and resilient. The target becomes subject to Hatred of all enemies, may ignore the negative effects of any Conditions or Diseases they suffer from, and gains +2 SL to any Toughness based Tests they are called on to make.

name: Bash ‘Em Lads!
text: The Shaman’s encouraging yawps fill his allies with fighting fervour. For every SL scored on the Casting roll, the Shaman may grant a point of Momentum to an allied Orc, Goblin, or Hobgoblin within range. Several points of Momentum may be granted to one target or spread among those available to the Shaman.
adaptation: Printed individual Advantage uses Momentum; the Fourth Edition Group Advantage alternative is omitted.

name: Brainbursta
text: Projecting his belligerence forth in a mental wave, the Shaman glowers at his target and assaults it with brain- melting force. The target immediately suffers from the Prone and Stunned Conditions, and an additional +1 Stunned for every +1 SL the Shaman scored on the Casting Test. If the Target suffers more Stunned Conditions than their Toughness Bonus, they must pass an immediate Average (+2 SL) Cool Test. If they fail the test, they take an immediate Critical Hit to their head.
adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty converted to Fifth Edition SL (core Appendix I p. 364).

name: ‘Eadbutt
text: The Shaman thrusts his head forward, projecting a force of malign green energy to assail those sensitive to magic. ‘Eadbutt is a magic missile that always strikes its target in the head with a Damage of +1. If the target has the Aethyric Attunement or Second Sight Talents, the spell strikes with a Damage of +6.
adaptation: Legacy: user-approved Target 1 resolves printed Target You conflicting with the magic-missile effect.

name: ‘Ere We Go!
text: The Shaman chants a stream of gibberish at his allies, infusing them with aggressive vigour. Targets within the Area of Effect gain +2 Momentum for all Melee Tests. If the Shaman casting this spell is a Hobgoblin the target of the spell will be Hobgoblins rather than Orcs.
adaptation: Printed individual Advantage uses Momentum; the Fourth Edition Group Advantage alternative is omitted.

name: The Evil Sun
text: Fuelled with vast power, the Shaman wills into existence a burning core of energy with great tusks and a leering face. Targets within the Area of Effect suffer 8+SL Damage every Round and must pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance Test or receive an Ablaze Condition every Round.

name: Fists of Gork
text: The Shaman’s gnarled fists grow large and become as hard as iron. The Shaman must drop any items he holds in his hands and may only attack with his fists, but counts as having Melee (Brawling) 55 and Weapon (Fists) +9 for the duration of the spell.

name: Foot of Gork
text: The Shaman raises his head and howls to the sky while waving his hands in bizarre patterns. Gork responds with an almighty foot which descends to crush anything underneath. All targets in the Area of Effect gain the Prone Condition and receive a Damage 8 hit to a random Hit Location ignoring Armour Points, or Damage 4 if they pass a Difficult (−1 SL) Dodge Test.
adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty converted to Fifth Edition SL (core Appendix I p. 364).

name: Gaze of Mork
text: A destructive beam of coruscating energy bursts from the Shaman’s eyes, hitting all in its path. Any living creature on a straight line in the direction of the blast is hit by a Damage +4 magic missile. Structures with 65 Toughness or less also take damage.

name: The Hand of Gork
text: The Shaman conjures an enormous ethereal green hand which scoops up 1d10 targets and plonks them down somewhere within range. Targets must be within Willpower Bonus yards of one another. On landing, they gain +1 Momentum in combat if they enter Melee immediately.
adaptation: Printed individual Advantage uses Momentum; the Fourth Edition Group Advantage alternative is omitted.

name: Mork Save Us!
text: The Shaman beseeches Mork to provide protection to his allies. For every SL scored on the casting roll, the Shaman may imbue an allied Orc, Goblin, or Hobgoblin within range with the Ward 10 Creature Trait. If the target already has a Ward Trait, the rating is improved by 1. A Ward Trait may not be improved to 7+ or better in this manner.

name: WAAAGH!
target: AoE (Willpower yards) all Orcs, Goblins, and Related Creatures within range — not just allies
text: An unstoppable surge of magical energy emanates from the Shaman, met by the roars of every Orc, Hobgoblin, and Goblin in the vicinity. All Orcs, Hobgoblins, and Goblins in the Area of Effect gain 1 Momentum for specific use on Melee and Ranged Tests. Remove any Broken Conditions and gain +2 SL to Cool and Endurance Tests for the duration of the spell.
adaptation: Printed individual Advantage uses Momentum; the Fourth Edition Group Advantage alternative is omitted.
